description: Processed AIS Vessel Trajectory Dataset for Multi-Horizon Prediction in Tampa Bay and the Port of New York (2024) Processed AIS Vessel Trajectory Dataset for Multi-Horizon Prediction in Tampa Bay and the Port of New York is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Tianhe Yang (PLA Information Engineering University). This dataset contains processed Automatic Identification System (AIS) vessel trajectories used for multi-horizon vessel trajectory prediction experiments in Tampa Bay and the Port of New York. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 86057270 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is ODC-BY. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
